requirements.title: INT argument restrictions
requirements.definition: A shall be integer, real, complex, enum, enumeration, or a BOZ literal constant; KIND shall be a scalar integer constant expression.

pending.INT-a-allowed-type-or-boz: Positive plan covers integer, exactly representable real, complex, enum, enumeration, and actual BOZ arguments; wrong-type mutation is source-control only with no diagnostic facet.
pending.INT-kind-scalar-integer-constant: Positive plan supplies KIND=KIND(0) and asserts the result kind equals KIND(0); nonconstant KIND mutation is source-control only.

requirements.title: INT conversion for integer, real, and complex arguments
requirements.definition: Integer A is unchanged; real A is truncated toward zero by magnitude and sign; complex A is converted as INT(REAL(A,KIND(A))).

pending.INT-integer-identity: Initialize the result sentinel to -777, evaluate INT(-42), assert exact -42, and mutate A to -41.
pending.INT-real-magnitude-less-than-one-zero: Use exactly representable 0.5 and -0.5, initialize sentinels to -777, assert exact zero for both, and include companion INT(1.5)=1 so zero is non-vacuous.
pending.INT-real-truncates-toward-zero: Use exactly representable 3.75 and -3.75, assert exact 3 and -3 from nonzero sentinels, and mutate sign or fractional magnitude.
pending.INT-complex-uses-real-part: Use CMPLX(-3.75,99.0), assert INT result -3 from a sentinel initialized to 777, and mutate to use AIMAG so the imaginary component is load-bearing.
